verdict.rationale: Gumloop's API/SDK reference covers creating and updating agents, starting sessions/chat completions, webhooks, MCP, skills, and artifacts (gumloop-docs-15, gumloop-docs-24, gumloop-docs-50), suggesting broad parity with UI concepts. However, there is no discoverable OpenAPI spec (gumloop-probe-2 shows all candidate spec URLs 404), and many UI-only surfaces (Slack/Teams/email agent access, agent performance dashboards, human-in-the-loop approval UI, organization skills sync) are described only as UI features with no confirmed API equivalents. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/full endpoint catalog, explicit API parity for HITL approvals, performance analytics, and channel integrations (Slack/Teams/email).
